name: Surf Green Orbit
inspiration: A Surf Green offset guitar on aged nitro lacquer, navigated like a Prezi spatial canvas. The whole site is one infinite stage; sections orbit a central tortoiseshell pick.

display.stack: 'Jost Variable', Futura, 'Century Gothic', 'Avenir Next', 'Trebuchet MS', sans-serif
display.note: Retro-surf geometric caps, generous letter-spacing on labels

body.stack: 'Archivo Variable', 'Avenir Next', Avenir, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif

utility.stack: 'JetBrains Mono Variable', ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Code', Consolas, Menlo, monospace

motion.note: Central pick hub with sections as orbiting knobs. Selecting one rotates the entire stage so the node reaches 12 o'clock, then the camera zooms ~9x into it while the section content staggers in. Back zooms out along the same path.
